name: co_statute
description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Colorado Revised Statutes (C.R.S.) — Colorado state law — by citation. "C.R.S. 18-3-102" is murder in the first degree. Returns the statutory text, the amendment "Source:" history, and cross references. Pass "year" (2000-current, except 2025 which is not yet supported) to get an older edition instead of the current one, e.g. to see how a section read before a given amendment. Keyless. Use for "what does C.R.S. 18-3-102 say", "Colorado landlord security deposit law", or to check a Colorado statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "18-3-102" (murder) or "38-12-103" (security deposits). Title-article-section; the title is the part before the first dash.

year.description: Optional. A C.R.S. edition year from 2000 through the current year, to retrieve a historical version of the section instead of the current one. Omit for the current edition.

name: co_titles
description: List the 44 titles of the Colorado Revised Statutes with their official names — Title 18 is the Criminal Code, Title 42 is Vehicles and Traffic, Title 38 is Property, and so on. Keyless. Use when you know the subject but not the title number, before calling co_statute or co_search.

subject.description: Optional subject to filter by, e.g. "divorce", "DUI", "landlord".

name: co_search
description: Search the Colorado Revised Statutes GENERAL INDEX by topic and get back matching index entries with their C.R.S. citations — e.g. "landlord", "security deposit", "concealed handgun", "driving under the influence". This is a real subject-index search, not just a title list: it finds the specific section(s) a plain-English topic maps to so you can pass them to co_statute. Works best with a SHORT topic (1-3 words) — the index is a nested tree (a topic heading followed by indented sub-entries that do not repeat the heading word), matched here within a small window of nearby lines, so a long compound phrase can miss or pick up a loosely related neighbor. Keyless.

query.description: Topic to search for, e.g. "landlord", "security deposit", "concealed handgun". Short phrases work best.
